findings.evidence: `buildSemiJoin` sets `joinPlan.JoinType = base.AntiSemiJoin` when `not` is true (`pkg/planner/core/logical_plan_builder.go:5270`) but also sets `joinPlan.PreferJoinType |= h.PreferRewriteSemiJoin` when `@@tidb_opt_enable_semi_join_rewrite` is ON (`pkg/planner/core/logical_plan_builder.go:5279`, `pkg/planner/core/logical_plan_builder.go:5280`). `SemiJoinRewriter` only matches `SemiJoin`/`LeftOuterSemiJoin` (`pkg/planner/core/rule_semi_join_rewrite.go:71`) so it never clears this bit on `AntiSemiJoin` joins; the bit-clear happens only on the handled join types (`pkg/planner/core/rule_semi_join_rewrite.go:79`). In physical planning, `isJoinHintSupportedInMPPMode` treats any non-HASH/Mpp hint bit as unsupported (`pkg/planner/core/logical_plan_builder.go:7204`, `pkg/planner/core/logical_plan_builder.go:7205`), so `PreferRewriteSemiJoin` makes it fail; `exhaustPhysicalPlans4LogicalJoin` then blocks MPP enumeration for flash properties (`pkg/planner/core/exhaust_physical_plans.go:2673`, `pkg/planner/core/exhaust_physical_plans.go:2682`) even though TiFlash MPP hash join explicitly supports `AntiSemiJoin` / `AntiLeftOuterSemiJoin` (`pkg/planner/core/exhaust_physical_plans.go:2448`). Checked `upstream/master` (3b531d4e3d99cb988bebccb8f63a96afff0ec6cd): same `buildSemiJoin` behavior remains.
findings.fix: In `buildSemiJoin`, only set `PreferRewriteSemiJoin` (and `rule.FlagSemiJoinRewrite`) for join types the rewrite rule can actually handle (e.g. `!not` and `joinPlan.JoinType == base.SemiJoin`; possibly also gate out `Anti*` joins). Alternatively (or additionally), explicitly clear `PreferRewriteSemiJoin` on `AntiSemiJoin`/`AntiLeftOuterSemiJoin` nodes before physical planning so it won’t be treated as a join-method hint and block MPP.
findings.impact: With `@@tidb_opt_enable_semi_join_rewrite=ON`, `NOT EXISTS` subqueries planned as `AntiSemiJoin` may be prevented from generating TiFlash/MPP join candidates (and can trigger misleading “used hint…” MPP warnings when MPP is enforced), even though TiFlash supports anti semi join. This is a planner/runtime compatibility regression gated by the new session variable.
findings.later_fix_evidence: `upstream/master` at 3b531d4e3d99cb988bebccb8f63a96afff0ec6cd still sets `PreferRewriteSemiJoin` in `buildSemiJoin` without excluding `Anti*` join types, and `isJoinHintSupportedInMPPMode` still rejects unknown prefer bits; no later fix found.
findings.verify: Manual check: `set @@tidb_allow_mpp=on; set @@tidb_opt_enable_semi_join_rewrite=on;` create tables with TiFlash replicas; run `explain` on a query containing `NOT EXISTS` and confirm an MPP join plan is still generated and no MPP/hint warning is emitted. Add a planner test covering `NOT EXISTS` under the sysvar to prevent regressions.
findings.what: `tidb_opt_enable_semi_join_rewrite` enables `PreferRewriteSemiJoin` on `AntiSemiJoin`/`AntiLeftOuterSemiJoin` (NOT EXISTS) joins, but the rewrite rule never clears/handles these join types; the leftover prefer-bit is then misclassified as an unsupported join-method hint under MPP and blocks TiFlash/MPP join enumeration for anti semi joins.

subject: planner: Exists subquery to join variable (#63416)
summary: This commit adds global/session sysvar `tidb_opt_enable_semi_join_rewrite` (default OFF) and wires it into planning by setting `PreferRewriteSemiJoin` and enabling `FlagSemiJoinRewrite`, plus updating the semi-join rewrite rule to gate on the session var. Main risk found: when the sysvar is ON, it also tags `NOT EXISTS` (AntiSemiJoin) joins with `PreferRewriteSemiJoin`, which is never cleared and can block TiFlash/MPP join planning due to join-hint validation.
